target.purpose: Detect, isolate, escalate, and recover from numerical-integrity failures across a distributed training step before corrupted state propagates.
target.central_bottleneck: A local NaN latch is insufficient when a distributed training job can contain rank-local non-finite values, overflow, runaway gradients, stale workers, or lost healthy quorum.
success: Single-rank numerical faults are quarantined while healthy quorum survives.
Lost quorum or repeated incidents open the controller and require checkpoint rollback.
Persistent OPEN failure escalates to HALT rather than silently resuming.
Recovery requires an explicit bounded sequence of clean observations.
Every modeled recovery path can emit an inspectable content-hashed receipt.
The original latched non-finite breaker remains available as a focused local primitive.

invariants: worker topology is complete and unique before a step can be evaluated
non-finite loss or gradients never count as healthy
lost healthy quorum cannot produce ALLOW
repeated incidents cannot remain indefinitely DEGRADED
OPEN state requires bounded clean recovery before returning CLOSED
persistent OPEN incidents escalate to HALT
receipt claims remain deterministic-model claims unless live framework evidence exists

composition.next: optional gradient-quorum adapter plus checkpoint provenance without collapsing specialist repos

nonclaims: no CUDA or NCCL execution is claimed
no production distributed-training deployment is claimed
no measured model convergence improvement is claimed
expansion_reason: Promoted the leaf from a local NaN latch into a proof-bound distributed training integrity and recovery controller while preserving the original primitive.
